description: The L2 `passphrase` returned by `createApiKey`/`deriveApiKey` (ApiKeyResponse) and by `createBuilderApiKey` (BuilderApiKeyResponse) is a credential: Polymarket's docs send it as the `POLY_PASSPHRASE` header on every authenticated request (https://docs.polymarket.com/getting-started/api.md, "Create L2 Credentials"). The spec does not mark it sensitive; `secret` in the same shapes already is.
